in_marathi.name: Bharwad
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Son of Bharata
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bharwad हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bharwad is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bharata’, meaning ‘son of Bharata’. This name holds a significant place in Hindu mythology as Bharata is the eldest of the Pandava brothers from the epic Mahabharata. The name is a symbol of leadership, courage, and righteousness.
